event_text: Hacker attack on Hugendubel's IT systems, per the company; it takes systems offline at once
notes: Date only; no clock time is given.

event_text: Hugendubel's website, web shop and service center become unreachable
notes: Per dpa and DerWesten: unreachable since Thursday.

event_text: A Hugendubel spokesperson tells dpa it was a hacker attack and that no customer data was stolen; the company's help page on the tolino cloud is updated
Netzwelt reports further details the company shared on social media, including that the outage may last several more days
notes: Company's post was read only through Netzwelt.

event_text: hugendubel.de still shows only the 'technical disruption' notice; the shop, service center and tolino cloud remain offline
Hugendubel's returns help page is updated: free return labels unavailable, return deadline extended
notes: Time is the page's own 'changed' stamp, read as Munich time.

event_text: LovelyBooks posts a statement, nearly identical to Hugendubel's, saying it was also hit by a cyberattack the same night
notes: Per TAG24; the post was not read directly.
